issue_context.title: cdc: Handle “value type is not BYTES: UNKNOWN” error
issue_context.body:
As reported by 2 customers, changefeed sometimes observe `value type is not BYTES: UNKNOWN` error.
This is a low level error, coming back from row fetcher (https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/9dda82c5283063dc54c954bedadda8580e27dea8/pkg/sql/row/fetcher.go#L797-L797).
The reason for this error are rather mysterious since changefeeds always target primary index span (so, no secondary indexes), and the error observed by the customers was always for the primary column family (familyID=0).
There are guesses we can make regarding why we're seeing this error (data corruption? bug in schema changer perhaps?).
Before we can get to the bottom of this issue, we should make sure that these low level decoding
errors are treated as permanent changefeed errors (there really is no point in retrying since we'd be getting 
the same error over and over again), and we should make this error very loud so that we have necessary information
included in the debug.zip in case this error resurfaces.

Jira issue: CRDB-29545

Epic CRDB-11783

review_comments: ewww? why is this going in the bytes, that have nothing to do with it? why not CombineErrors or Wrapf?
I could have wrapped another error here... true.. Just wans't done.. cause it's really "surprising" and I didn't care to repeat logging/wrap...
